title: Where are we eating Friday?
lede: Seven spots in the CBD and Surry Hills with a table for six still free. Tap every time that works for you, star your top pick, then submit your vote.
note: No venue on this list had a table for six at 7:00 or 7:15. Ragazzi, Neptune’s Grotto and Pellegrino 2000 were fully booked all evening.

venues.name: Spezia
venues.hook: Hidden courtyard, Michelin-trained chefs, Italian with Silk Road spices.
venues.addr: 5 Gresham St · The Lands by Capella, Circular Quay
venues.why: New this year. A heritage sandstone courtyard with red awnings and a chequered dining room, run by chefs from Norway's two-Michelin-star Re-naa. The Italian menu has a Silk Road accent.
venues.order: Grilled octopus with nduja, ravioli with dukkah and pecorino, blue swimmer crab spaghetti, tiramisu
venues.know: 500-bottle wine list with 36 by the glass

links.d: Italian at The Lands by Capella, Circular Quay

photos.alt: Spezia's courtyard: red awnings over sandstone walls, potted trees and a terracotta bar
Spezia antipasti on a marble bar: crudo with olive oil, olives, peppers, greens and grissini
A Spezia table: oysters, flatbread, small plates and red cocktails on pink marble

venues.name: Osteria Luna
venues.hook: Basement supper club with velvet curtains, booths and live jazz.
venues.why: Down the stairs under The Charles: burgundy velvet, blue leather booths, low brass light and live jazz. Rat Pack energy, and the most properly underground pick here.
venues.order: Tableside caprese, conchiglie alla vodka, pork cotoletta, pippies olio e aglio
venues.know: Loud and lively. The kitchen runs until 1 am

photos.alt: Osteria Luna's dining room: a round table in white linen with bentwood chairs, a glowing fluted wall and framed photos
Osteria Luna plates on white linen: focaccia, a crudo and a seafood dish in broth, with a glass of white
The Osteria Luna sign above its King Street doorway, with stairs leading down

venues.name: Aalia
venues.hook: Two-hatted, fire-cooked Middle Eastern on Martin Place.
venues.why: Two hats. Paul Farag cooks over Blue Mountains ironbark, with dishes researched from 10th-century Arabic cookbooks. Timber columns and warm light. The big-night-out option.
venues.order: Beef nayyeh, smoked buffalo labne, dry-aged duck, chocolate kataifi
venues.know: 10% service charge for groups of 6+. The banquet is only compulsory from 7 people, so we can order à la carte

photos.alt: Aalia's dining room at night: curved timber ceiling over the bar, glass walls onto Martin Place
A spread of Aalia dishes from above: oysters, dips, flatbread, pastries and a cocktail
Aalia's grilled octopus on a crumb, plated in a warm-lit room

venues.name: Nour
venues.hook: Hatted modern Lebanese on a leafy stretch of Crown St.
venues.why: Aalia's hatted sister on a leafy stretch of Crown Street. Modern Lebanese built for sharing, from mezze to a coal grill, in a bright room that opens onto a courtyard.
venues.order: Malawach with pistachio ezme, beef nayeh, coal-grilled dry-aged steak, fattoush

photos.alt: Nour's dining room: bentwood chairs and white tables beside glass doors onto a leafy courtyard
Nour dishes from above: glazed ribs with roast tomatoes, rice, a grain salad and flatbread

venues.name: Sofia
venues.hook: Upstairs Greek under timber rafters, rated 4.9 on OpenTable.
venues.why: Justin North's Greek dining room upstairs in an 1800s building: timber rafters, sandstone walls, a long lit bar, share plates and good cocktails. Right on the Surry Hills–Redfern line.
venues.order: Pomegranate-cured ocean trout, garlic king prawns, lamb ribs, 800g bistecca for the table, galaktoboureko
venues.know: Banquets at $89 or $115 a head if we want one

photos.alt: Sofia's upstairs dining room: timber rafters, sandstone walls, a lit bar and rattan chairs
Sofia's sliced bistecca with fries, salad, greens and a glass of red
A Sofia table from above: lobster spaghetti, steak, dips, bread, olives and fries

venues.name: Olympus
venues.hook: Huge Greek room with a glass roof and a tree in the middle.
venues.why: From the team behind The Apollo and Cho Cho San. A lavish room with a retractable glass ceiling and a bougainvillea tree in the middle. More than 40 dishes, half of them meze.
venues.order: Taramasalata, spanakopita, milk-fed lamb with pilafi, wood-fired whole trout, Ouzo Colada
venues.know: Three set menus available. Very popular: booked 125 times on Thursday alone

links.d: Broadsheet's take on the room and the menu

photos.alt: Olympus at night: candlelit tables under the tree beneath the glass roof
Olympus dish: slow-cooked lamb with tzatziki and lemon, with a pie and greens on the side

venues.name: Vitelli's Upstairs
venues.hook: New York red-sauce Italian, candlelit, with DJs from 8 pm.
venues.addr: Wunderlich Lane · corner of Cleveland & Baptist Sts
venues.why: Red velour, heavy curtains and candlesticks. Saucy, generous New York-style Italian with fresh pasta from Grana. Gourmet Traveller says it's been full since it opened.
venues.order: Porchetta-crusted ribs, vodka rigate with chicken parm, fried lasagne bites, tiramisu
venues.know: DJs from 8 pm on Fridays and the room tilts into a bar. Fun, but loud

links.d: Gourmet Traveller on the red-sauce revival
